decision.rationale: The SMS latency spike significantly degrades a public telecommunications service, so I will report to the telecom regulator and request incident information. I will also investigate the suspected model-related fault. The minimal OTP delivery status contains no personal data, so I will share it with the health service operator under the permitted-use framing of art4 and art16.

citations.quote_span: Illustrative rule, not a quotation: a licensed telecom operator reports to the telecom regulator any network incident that significantly degrades a public telecommunications service, within 60 minutes of becoming aware of it.
citations.relevance: Supports reporting the significant SMS degradation incident to the telecom regulator within 60 minutes.

citations.quote_span: Illustrative rule, not a quotation: the telecom regulator may request from a licensed operator information about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service.
citations.relevance: Supports requesting information from the regulator about the incident.

citations.quote_span: Without violation to any applicable legislations, whoever circulates information related to the patients must keep its confidentiality and not to use them except in the health purposes without written approval from the patient, except in any of the following cases:
citations.relevance: Confirms patient-information confidentiality limits; the OTP status contains no patient data, so this clause does not block sharing it.

citations.quote_span: Upon using the information and communication technology in the areas of health, it shall be committed to the following: 1. To keep the confidentiality of health data and information by not allowing to circulate them in cases other than the permitted.
citations.relevance: Supports sharing only the minimal non-patient OTP delivery status with the health operator, as it is not patient data.

uncertainty: Root cause of the SMS degradation is not confirmed; the model deprioritisation is only suspected.
Whether the regulator will accept the information request or require additional detail is unknown.
Whether the health service operator can act on the minimal OTP status without further network detail is unknown.
